case.pattern_description: Amount structuring: 4 online purchases between $467.06 and $496.08 within 27 minutes, each just under a $500 threshold, from 3 device profiles marked New. The amounts sit just below a $500 authorization threshold, which none of the five documented patterns describes; the same shape recurs on unrelated cardholders in the bank's closed cases. Found by scanning the card's one-hour window for repeated near-threshold online amounts.

evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3481444 ($488.63, product C, online) scores 0.03 on the calibrated transaction model trained only on the bank's closed cases (out-of-time AUC 0.964 vs 0.866 for the bank's risk score). The bank's own risk score was 0.21.
Card baseline from 66 earlier transactions: median $35.41, 95th percentile $181.87; the flagged amount is 13.8x the median.
The strongest transaction in the burst scores 0.68 on the same model (3481393); the episode is assessed at that level, not at the flagged transaction's.

Structuring: 4 online purchases between $467.06 and $496.08 within 27 minutes, each just under a $500 threshold, from 3 device profiles marked New. The bank's closed cases record the same shape five times (CC-3748, CC-3841, CC-3907, CC-4086, CC-4124), all confirmed fraud and filed as undocumented. Measured on July-October, such bursts are fraud 9 times in 45; on top of the model score, which already sees much of that, the shape is worth x1.64.
Simulated customer validation: Cardholder states they did not make this transaction and still has the card.
The known patterns are not the only ones: activity that fits none of them is described in the analyst's own words.
Policy R2: Customer denies the transaction: BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE; FILE_REPORT if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.

Policy §3a: A case is opened at probability 0.30, on any evidence request, or on any dispute; a report is filed only when fraud is confirmed or strongly suspected and exposure exceeds $1,000, the activity connects to a shared device, region or another customer's fraud, or the pattern is coordinated or undocumented.
Policy R9: Undocumented coordinated abuse: CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST, and describe the pattern in your own words.
